_comment: The ways to win the game. A path opens once every unlock step is done (none: open from the start) and is won once
every goal step is done too. A step is:
{ "type": "beatAll" }      every racer beaten at least once
{ "type": "mostWins" }     more wins than any other racer (the King left out)
step is its text once done, todo while still to do ({target}, {current}, {remaining} are filled in); a goal step
of a path not yet open shows as (Locked). progress is the line under the name: achieved, unlocked (open, not won)
and locked, with {TotalWins} and the other counters by name, {defeated} and {total} filled in.
The ids are kept in saves: a path picked in a save whose mod is gone is no path until it is back.
